scenes.name: overworld-static-spin
scenes.focus: frustum culling, terrain draw calls, vertex count
scenes.replay: Load the spawn area, hold the camera-spin input for the sample window, and do not mutate blocks.

scenes.name: cave-occlusion-stress
scenes.focus: occlusion candidates and hidden chunk overhead
scenes.replay: Load the marked cave fixture and rotate through the four cardinal views without changing blocks.

scenes.name: high-speed-flight-streaming
scenes.focus: chunk generation, meshing, and worker queue depth
scenes.replay: Fly the recorded straight-line route at the fixed speed; restart from the same seed for every repetition.

scenes.name: high-density-redstone
scenes.replay: Activate the same lever sequence from the fixture; leave the camera stationary during sampling.

scenes.name: fluid-lighting-stress
scenes.replay: Run the fixture's water and torch mutation sequence once during warmup, then observe.

scenes.name: entity-crowd-wall-occlusion
scenes.focus: entity update, mesh assembly, and culling
scenes.replay: Spawn the fixture crowd before warmup and alternate the two marked camera cells during sampling.

scenes.name: autosave-continuous-dirty
scenes.focus: save I/O, queue depth, and region cache memory
scenes.replay: Apply the fixed block mutation cadence; allow autosave to run and do not manually save.

scenes.name: multiplayer-host-client-join
scenes.focus: packet encoding, interpolation, and network queues
scenes.replay: Start the host and client from the fixture script, join once, and keep both peers on the recorded route.
